title: MLP-RL-CRD: diagnosis of cardiovascular risk in athletes using a reinforcement learning-based multilayer perceptron
summary: A reinforcement-learning multilayer perceptron with mutual-learning artificial-bee-colony initialization was trained on 26,002 athletes and assessed against expert ECG labels, reporting an F-measure of 87.4% and a geometric mean of 89.6% against conventional and deep baselines. This is a retrospective athlete-screening result limited to the study dataset, with no prospective or external cohort, and it is not evidence of clinical benefit.
